propositions: The packaged plan-review author guide should tell clients not to state the number of children in an epic description.
The guide should tell clients an epic needs no separate acceptance criterion requiring all children to be closed or completed.
Child closure before parent completion is already enforced deterministically, so author guidance is the appropriate fix rather than changing plan-review or completion-verifier behavior.
Guidance should steer epic authors toward durable epic outcomes and decomposition instead of volatile graph metadata.
No change-detector regression test should be added; existing guide packaging and rendering checks plus review of rendered output verify the change.
